subject.title: refactor: remove expired plugin compatibility surfaces

question: Does the approved early-July compatibility-removal exception authorize removing every selected record dated through 2026-07-30 in the release targeted by this PR?
rationale: The branch intentionally advances removal ahead of some registry dates; author-reported approval is useful context, but the supplied visible discussion does not independently establish the release owner’s final decision for this exact head and release.

options.title: Confirm the early sweep
options.body: Record that this release may remove the selected July 24–30 compatibility records, with the six known live contracts remaining deferred.

options.title: Honor each recorded date
options.body: Defer records whose `removeAfter` date is later than the target release date and land only the already-expired subset.

options.title: Delay the release
options.body: Keep the full sweep intact but release after the latest selected July removal date.

recommendation.title: Confirm the early sweep
recommendation.body: Record that this release may remove the selected July 24–30 compatibility records, with the six known live contracts remaining deferred.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the person coordinating the registry sweep and documenting the claimed approval; confidence is limited because an explicit release-owner identity is not present in the supplied context.
